correctness.rationale: Headline: on Gamma0=unit K3,3 genus 4, D0=sum of midpoints of three disjoint matching edges has Baker-Norine (metric) rank exactly 0, refuting target rank-1 premise. Proof structure verified: (i) Model G2 (subdivide each K3,3 edge once: 15 vertices, 18 edges, b1=4, originals trivalent, midpoints 2-valent) correctly models Gamma0 with D0 and q=a0 vertex-supported. (ii) Dhar burning trace for D0-a0 from a0 independently replayed by auditor: 15/15 vertices burn in stated order; each step satisfies D[v]<edges-to-burned (0<1 for frontier, 1<2 for chip vertices m11,m22,m00 with two burned neighbors). Whole burn => D0-a0 is a0-reduced with value -1 at a0 => by Baker-Norine/Luo reduced-divisor criterion not equivalent to any effective divisor (including interior-supported) => r(D0)<=0; D0 effective => r=0. (iii) Independent exact Laplacian-lattice check replayed: 0/120 effective degree-2 vertex divisors make D0-a0-E principal, corroborating unwinnability. Subdivision sweeps (n=2,4,6,8) and sanity controls (3*a0 winnable, canonical degree 6) corroborate code. Metric-vs-discrete step (vertex-supported Dhar captures metric reducedness for this pair) is standard Luo theory; burning inequalities were verified to propagate metrically along half-edges. No lift verdict claimed, correctly mooted. Limitations honestly stated (named divisor only; star triple not certified). This is proof, not mere experiment.
